name: Faster-whisper
description: Faster-whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for Transformer models. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for faster-whisper.
short_desc: Faster-whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for T
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: DEBUG
form_fields.hint: If set to true, or any other value, the container will output debug logs.

form_fields.label: LOCAL_ONLY
form_fields.hint: If set to true, or any other value, the container will not attempt to download models from HuggingFace and will only use locally-provided models.

form_fields.label: WHISPER_BEAM
form_fields.hint: Number of candidates to consider simultaneously during transcription.

form_fields.label: WHISPER_LANG
form_fields.hint: Two character code for the language that you will speak to the add-on.

form_fields.label: WHISPER_MODEL
form_fields.hint: Whisper model that will be used for transcription. From here.
